title: Lite Matter Engineering
purpose: Use the real Molecular Analyzer and Martian Desh sample to record matter without enabling replication.
optimization_opportunities: Reuse prepared interplanetary samples, stable power, and automated material lines; avoid one-off rebuilding.
infrastructure_reuse: The real Analyzer, Mars Sample, power grid, and material factories become inputs to AI-era matter research.

milestones.title: Molecular Analyzer
final_validation: Craft the existing Molecular Analyzer from meteorite iron, an advanced computer, steel, an IC2 MV machine block, advanced circuits, and Desh.

milestones.title: Power the Analyzer
final_validation: Supply the existing Analyzer with at least 50,000 FE for a Desh analysis.

milestones.title: Martian Material Pattern Record
final_validation: Insert Galacticraft Desh metadata 2 and complete the existing 50,000 FE analysis to produce a non-consumable pattern record.

milestones.title: Comparative Molecular Characterization
final_validation: Record planned Earth, lunar, and Martian material comparisons without enabling arbitrary transmutation.

milestones.title: Advanced Material Recovery
final_validation: Demonstrate efficient recycling or high-purity recovery using existing industrial machines.

milestones.title: Lite Matter Engineering Complete
final_validation: Demonstrate molecular analysis, durable pattern records, and advanced recovery without UU-Matter or replication.
